statement: The revived CPX is reported to carry a maximum power rating of 2,300 watts and to require a separate MGX ETL rack configuration.
why: Per-accelerator power at this level forces liquid cooling and new rack power design, which pulls spending into the electrical and cooling supply chain.

impact.mechanism: Higher per-part power ratings and a dedicated rack format increase demand for advanced cooling and electrical distribution per deployed accelerator.

evidence.source: Investing.com (citing TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo)
evidence.excerpt: a maximum power rating of 2,300 watts

reasoning: Power and rack details come from the same unconfirmed analyst note about a 2027 part; the infrastructure pull follows logically but depends on the product actually shipping as described.

confidence.basis: Unconfirmed specification for an unreleased product from a single analyst note.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 1; sources: Investing.com (citing TF International Securities analyst Ming-Chi Kuo), Investing.com earnings call transcript (NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call)
